"""
serve_dashboard.py

A minimal, safe dashboard server that validates HTML files before serving them.

Safety features:
- SAFE_MODE = True (refuses to serve files that fail validation)
- Only serves files from a configured DASHBOARD_DIR
- Path traversal protection
- Validates that any CSS classes used in the HTML belong to an approved allow-list
- Refuses to serve files containing inline <script> tags, inline event handlers,
  inline style attributes, or <style> blocks with unknown class selectors
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import html
import os
import re
from http import HTTPStatus
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# When True, any file that fails validation is refused (HTTP 403).
# When False, files would be served as-is. Keep this True in production.
SAFE_MODE: bool = True

# Directory containing dashboard HTML files. Only files inside this directory
# (after resolving symlinks) will ever be served.
DASHBOARD_DIR: Path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "dashboard"

# Bind address / port for the local server.
HOST: str = "127.0.0.1"
PORT: int = 8000

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Approved CSS class allow-list
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Only these CSS classes may appear in served HTML. Any class attribute that
# references an unknown class will cause validation to fail in SAFE_MODE.
APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    # Layout
    "container", "row", "col", "grid", "grid-item",
    "header", "footer", "main", "sidebar", "section",
    # Dashboard widgets
    "dashboard", "card", "card-title", "card-body", "card-footer",
    "metric", "metric-label", "metric-value",
    "chart", "chart-title", "chart-legend",
    "table", "table-row", "table-cell", "table-header",
    # Status / utility
    "status", "status-ok", "status-warn", "status-error",
    "badge", "tag", "muted", "highlight",
    "btn", "btn-primary", "btn-secondary",
    # Typography
    "title", "subtitle", "text", "text-small", "text-bold",
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Matches class="..." or class='...' attributes (case-insensitive).
_CLASS_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
    r"""\bclass\s*=\s*(?P<quote>["'])(?P<value>.*?)(?P=quote)""",
    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)

# Matches <script ...>...</script> blocks (any content).
_SCRIPT_TAG_RE = re.compile(r"<\s*script\b", re.IGNORECASE)

# Matches inline event handlers like onclick="...", onload='...'.
_INLINE_EVENT_RE = re.compile(r"\son[a-z]+\s*=", re.IGNORECASE)

# Matches inline style="..." attributes.
_INLINE_STYLE_RE = re.compile(r"\sstyle\s*=", re.IGNORECASE)

# Matches class selectors inside <style> blocks: .my-class
_STYLE_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
    r"<\s*style\b[^>]*>(?P<body>.*?)<\s*/\s*style\s*>",
    re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)
_CSS_CLASS_SELECTOR_RE = re.compile(r"\.([A-Za-z_][\w-]*)")


class ValidationError(Exception):
    """Raised when an HTML file fails the dashboard validation rules."""


def _extract_used_classes(html_text: str) -> set[str]:
    """Return the set of CSS class names referenced via class="..." attributes."""
    used: set[str] = set()
    for match in _CLASS_ATTR_RE.finditer(html_text):
        value = match.group("value")
        # class attribute can contain multiple whitespace-separated names
        for name in value.split():
            name = name.strip()
            if name:
                used.add(name)
    return used


def _extract_style_block_classes(html_text: str) -> set[str]:
    """Return CSS class names defined as selectors inside <style> blocks."""
    classes: set[str] = set()
    for block in _STYLE_BLOCK_RE.finditer(html_text):
        body = block.group("body")
        for m in _CSS_CLASS_SELECTOR_RE.finditer(body):
            classes.add(m.group(1))
    return classes


def validate_html(
    html_text: str,
    approved: Iterable[str] = APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES,
) -> None:
    """Validate an HTML document against the dashboard safety rules.

    Raises ValidationError on the first problem encountered.
    """
    approved_set = frozenset(approved)

    # 1) No inline scripts.
    if _SCRIPT_TAG_RE.search(html_text):
        raise ValidationError("Inline <script> tags are not allowed.")

    # 2) No inline event handlers (onclick, onload, ...).
    if _INLINE_EVENT_RE.search(html_text):
        raise ValidationError("Inline event handlers (on*) are not allowed.")

    # 3) No inline style="..." attributes.
    if _INLINE_STYLE_RE.search(html_text):
        raise ValidationError("Inline style attributes are not allowed.")

    # 4) Every class used in markup must be in the approved list.
    used_classes = _extract_used_classes(html_text)
    unknown_used = used_classes - approved_set
    if unknown_used:
        raise ValidationError(
            "Unapproved CSS class(es) used in markup: "
            + ", ".join(sorted(unknown_used))
        )

    # 5) Every class selector defined in <style> blocks must also be approved.
    style_classes = _extract_style_block_classes(html_text)
    unknown_styles = style_classes - approved_set
    if unknown_styles:
        raise ValidationError(
            "Unapproved CSS class selector(s) defined in <style>: "
            + ", ".join(sorted(unknown_styles))
        )


def validate_html_file(path: Path) -> None:
    """Read a file from disk and validate its HTML contents."""
    try:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ValidationError(f"Could not read file: {exc}") from exc
    validate_html(text)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HTTP server
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _resolve_safe_path(url_path: str) -> Path | None:
    """Resolve a URL path to a real file inside DASHBOARD_DIR.

    Returns None if the path escapes DASHBOARD_DIR or does not point to a
    regular .html file that exists.
    """
    # Strip query string / fragment, default to index.html.
    clean = url_path.split("?", 1)[0].split("#", 1)[0]
    if clean in ("", "/"):
        clean = "/index.html"

    # Disallow obvious traversal characters before joining.
    if "\x00" in clean or ".." in clean.split("/"):
        return None

    candidate = (DASHBOARD_DIR / clean.lstrip("/")).resolve()

    try:
        candidate.relative_to(DASHBOARD_DIR.resolve())
    except ValueError:
        return None  # Outside DASHBOARD_DIR

    if not candidate.is_file():
        return None
    if candidate.suffix.lower() != ".html":
        return None
    return candidate


class DashboardHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "SafeDashboard/1.0"

    def _send_text(self, status: HTTPStatus, body: str,
                   content_type: str = "text/plain; charset=utf-8") -> None:
        encoded = body.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(encoded)))
        self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(encoded)

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 (BaseHTTPRequestHandler API)
        path = _resolve_safe_path(self.path)
        if path is None:
            self._send_text(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, "404 Not Found\n")
            return

        try:
            validate_html_file(path)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            if SAFE_MODE:
                msg = (
                    "403 Forbidden: file failed dashboard validation.\n"
                    f"File: {path.name}\n"
                    f"Reason: {html.escape(str(exc))}\n"
                )
                self._send_text(HTTPStatus.FORBIDDEN, msg)
                return
            # SAFE_MODE disabled: log to stderr but serve anyway.
            self.log_error("Validation failed for %s: %s", path, exc)

        try:
            content = path.read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            self._send_text(
                HTTPStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                f"500 Internal Server Error: {exc}\n",
            )
            return

        self.send_response(HTTPStatus.OK)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(content)))
        self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(content)


def main() -> None:
    DASHBOARD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print(f"SAFE_MODE = {SAFE_MODE}")
    print(f"Serving validated HTML from: {DASHBOARD_DIR}")
    print(f"Listening on http://{HOST}:{PORT}")
    with ThreadingHTTPServer((HOST, PORT), DashboardHandler) as httpd:
        try:
            httpd.serve_forever()
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\nShutting down.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
serve_dashboard.py

A minimal, safe dashboard server that validates HTML files before serving them.

Safety features:
- SAFE_MODE = True (refuses to serve files that fail validation)
- Binds only to 127.0.0.1:6060 (localhost only)

import re
from http import HTTPStatus
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES: frozenset = frozenset({
    # Layout
    "container", "row", "col", "grid", "grid-item",
    "header", "footer", "main", "sidebar", "section",
    # Dashboard widgets

    classes = set()

            classes.add(m.group(1))
    return classes

    html_text: str,
    approved: Iterable = APPROVED_CSS_CLASSES,
) -> None:
    """Validate HTML content. Raises ValidationError on first failure."""
    approved_set = frozenset(approved)

    if _SCRIPT_TAG_RE.search(html_text):
        raise ValidationError("Inline <script> tags are not allowed.")
    if _INLINE_EVENT_RE.search(html_text):
        raise ValidationError("Inline event handlers (on*) are not allowed.")

        raise ValidationError("Inline style attributes are not allowed.")

        )

            + ", ".join(sorted(unknown_styles))
        )


def validate_html_file(path: Path) -> None:
    try:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        raise ValidationError(f"Could not read file: {exc}") from exc

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Server
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _resolve_safe_path(url_path: str) -> Optional[Path]:
    """Resolve a URL path to an .html file inside DASHBOARD_DIR, or None."""

        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(content)

    DASHBOARD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
